title: Add call-site listing default to defaults.toml
summary: Add one [[default]] entry to defaults.toml, id "call-sites": a job that changes a function's or type's signature or behavior must list every call site found by whole-repo search, each as a deliverable with a covering test or an explicit exclusion, and carry the list in the change description for the verifier. Audience: the reader, producer and verifier, who see it via the rendered defaults. It is marked prose-only.

defaults_applied.how: The new rule is explicitly marked prose-only.
A test covers the new default's selection and rendering; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria check the rendered default appearing for code requests, not just that the file exists.
Applies unasked as a standing default.
One focused entry, with tests and a changelog line.
The statement is written for an outside reader.
Independent verification by running cargo test, clippy and fmt.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs (DefaultsModel::parse, render shows only each statement's first sentence, REPO_DEFAULTS include_str test), crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (standing-default tests near line 4616), and crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs (reader budget line, 2000 tokens). Selection order: the reader names applicable defaults, then only those reach the producer and verifier briefs. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched.

Reader prompt is at 1997 of 2000 tokens (docs/system-facts.md) and renders defaults. A new entry may overflow the budget. The producer must keep the first sentence short, or if the budget test fails, update the budget figure and docs/system-facts.md consistently and state that in the change.
Marked prose-only because no loop code can detect call sites; the mechanism default is satisfied by saying so explicitly in the statement.

applies_to is ["code", "tests", "build"]. The source cites this request, since the job id is unknown to the reader: source = "user request: default for call-site listing on signature or behavior changes".
Environment: none; no CI workflow, push or history read.

acceptance_criteria.text: defaults.toml has a new [[default]] with id "call-sites", applies_to including "code", and a source citing the user's request. Its statement says that a job changing a function's or type's signature or behavior lists every call site, found by searching the whole repo and not from memory, in the reading or plan.
The statement says each call site is either a deliverable with a covering test or an explicit exclusion with a reason, and that the change description carries the list for the verifier.
The statement is explicitly marked prose-only, matching the style of the other standing defaults, and its first sentence states the core rule because render shows only that sentence.

Run `cargo test` from the root: all tests pass, including repository_defaults_parse and the athena-data defaults tests plus the prompt-budget and system-facts tests. If the reader budget changed, docs/system-facts.md matches the computed figure.

Run `cargo test`: a test in crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs shows that rendering the repo defaults for a code-class request contains a line starting "- call-sites [" and for a docs-only request does not.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.

CHANGELOG.md gets an entry for the new default, and docs/design/defaults-loop.md's count of defaults (currently 15) is updated if it enumerates them. defaults.toml is named as the governance file changed.

out_of_scope: Code that detects call sites or enforces the convention by mechanism
Editing prompt files or changing athena.toml
departures: The reader prompt budget has 3 tokens of headroom, so the new entry may force budget and system-facts changes. That adds some risk of failed verification.
